entry.title: PPI for final demand advances 0.3% in September; goods rise 0.9%, services unchanged
entry.summary: The Producer Price Index for final demand increased 0.3 percent in September. Prices for final demand goods advanced 0.9 percent, and the index for final demand services was unchanged.
